label: HOLD_PAT_SCOPE_UNSAFE_OR_AMBIGUOUS

mechanical_observations.other_owner_repo_seen_example: smart1llc/Luxury-MIami (different owner present in token-visible list)

interpretation: Token authenticates as the owner and is fine-grained (no classic scopes), but (a) it returns 404 on the sandbox repo — it is NOT granted access to the intended sandbox — and (b) its token-scoped /user/repos enumeration returns 100+ repositories across multiple owners, which is broader/more ambiguous than the single-repo read-only token this gate requires. FounderGate holds: it will not perform intake with a token whose scope it cannot verify as narrow, and it fetched NO contents of any non-sandbox repository.
